messages:
Ravi: Quick RFC follow-up re: deprecating per-tenant egress sidecars for private/VPC customers. Idea: run a shared regional egress-connector that can preserve source IPs when requested.
Elaine: Sounds promising. Top concerns: source-IP for customer allowlists, TLS material handling, and auditability.
Noah: Hybrid approach: connector attempts ENI-based preservation (reserve ENI per tenant), fallback to stable SNAT mapping with tenant-scoped public IP.
Priya: Control plane needs to issue short-lived attestations bound to connector instance identity. Connector fetches ephemeral certs; no long-lived tenant keys in pods.
Ravi: Proposed connector knobs:
- mode: permissive|strict
- preservationPool: 30
- eniWarmupSecs: 25
Example: connector.mode=permissive;preservationPool=30;eniWarmup=25
Elaine: Observability: emit metrics: tenant_id, path=(ENI|SNAT), dst_cidr, p95_latency, egress_5xx_count. Log original_src when SNAT applied.
Noah: Failure semantics: permissive -> route back to sidecar for a short window; strict -> fail-closed. Healthcheck transitions should be auditable.
Priya: Rollout: opt-in tenant flag, staging soak, 1% canary, 10% canary, broad. Add "preview IPs" in console and an audit trail for cutovers.
Ravi: Ops checklist: verify TGW route limits, ENI attach latency (<30s), NACL/SG allowances, and ENI warm pool sizing.
Elaine: Product callout: offer managed static-egress-ip as an add-on for customers needing guaranteed dedicated IPs.
InfraBot: Scheduled deploy: connector v0.9.0 to staging 2026-04-02T22:30Z (pipeline #2329). Canary tests enabled.
Ravi: Action items: @Elaine write onboarding + rollback doc, @Noah spike on TGW/ENI scale, @Priya implement attestation flow, I'll draft RFC delta.
